texts.label: text
texts.orig: In line with our country's activities to commemorate the first anniversary of Tata Mandela's death, the SANDF held a Mandela Commemorative Medal Parade at Air Force Waterkloof in Pretoria last month Base
texts.text: In line with our country's activities to commemorate the first anniversary of Tata Mandela's death, the SANDF held a Mandela Commemorative Medal Parade at Air Force Waterkloof in Pretoria last month Base

texts.label: text
texts.orig: President Jacob Zuma, the President of South Africa and Commander-in-Chief of the SANDF, functionary at the medal parade: He awarded medals to SANDF men and women for their role in taking care of our statesman during the period when he was ill, his funeral, the mourning period arrangements, the lying-in state at the Union Buildings and leading the state funeral at Qunu. gold

texts.orig: President Zuma expressed his gratitude and admiration to the SANDF for carrying out its duties towards its first Commander-in Chief.
